This explorer extends the manuscript vaccination-group analyses to every
original age stratum with an available fitted result. Choose separate low- and
high-vaccination thresholds, then add, remove, or reassign individual countries
or states. Automatic threshold assignments include locations with at least 95%
usable panel-specific observations from 2020 onward. Locations below that
coverage remain available for manual exploration, and the manuscript preset is
also available for direct comparison.

```{=html}
<div id="supplementary-vaccination-groups" class="vax-app" data-vaccination-app data-root="assets/supplementary/vaccination_groups">
  <div class="vax-controls" aria-label="Vaccination-group explorer filters">
    <label>Analysis
      <select data-control="figure">
        <option value="figure_04">P-score by vaccination group</option>
        <option value="figure_05">Female-minus-male P-score difference</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label>Region
      <select data-control="region">
        <option value="europe">Europe</option>
        <option value="us">United States</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label>Original age group
      <select data-control="age"></select>
    </label>
    <label>Display window
      <select data-control="window">
        <option value="2020" selected>2020 onward</option>
        <option value="full">Full available history</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label>Low if coverage is below (%)
      <input type="number" min="0" max="100" step="0.1" data-control="low-threshold" inputmode="decimal">
    </label>
    <label>High if coverage is above (%)
      <input type="number" min="0" max="100" step="0.1" data-control="high-threshold" inputmode="decimal">
    </label>
  </div>

  <div class="vax-command-bar">
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-action="apply-thresholds">Apply thresholds</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-default" data-action="manuscript-preset">Load manuscript preset</button>
    <span class="vax-status" data-role="status" aria-live="polite">Loading frozen vaccination summaries…</span>
  </div>

  <div class="vax-meta" data-role="metadata"></div>

  <div class="vax-chart-shell">
    <svg data-role="chart" viewBox="0 0 920 500" role="img" aria-label="Vaccination-group trajectory"></svg>
    <div class="vax-tooltip" data-role="tooltip" hidden></div>
  </div>

  <div class="vax-actions">
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-default" data-action="download-curves">Download aggregated curves</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-default" data-action="download-membership">Download current membership</button>
  </div>

  <section class="vax-membership" aria-labelledby="vax-membership-heading">
    <div class="vax-section-heading">
      <div>
        <h2 id="vax-membership-heading">Group membership</h2>
        <p>Selections update the chart immediately. Limited-coverage locations are excluded automatically but can still be assigned manually. Choose Excluded to remove a location, or Low/High to add it to either group.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="vax-table-shell">
      <table>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th scope="col">Country or state</th>
            <th scope="col">Vaccinated (%)</th>
            <th scope="col">Measurement date</th>
            <th scope="col">Model status</th>
            <th scope="col">Usable / expected</th>
            <th scope="col">Missing observations</th>
            <th scope="col">Coverage (%)</th>
            <th scope="col">Group</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody data-role="membership-body"></tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </section>
</div>

<noscript>This explorer requires JavaScript. Frozen geography-level summaries and membership tables remain available from the <a href="supplementary.html">supplementary landing page</a>.</noscript>
```

Both groups are aggregated date by date with inverse-variance fixed-effect
weights, using dates shared by every selected location. The P-score analysis
shows its normal-approximation interval as a ribbon. The female-minus-male
P-score difference uses dashed interval bounds; European sex-contrast
trajectories use the same centered 14-day box smoother as the manuscript
analysis. Locations without the required paired sex-stratified result are shown
explicitly and cannot be assigned for that panel.

All browser assets are summary-only. The frozen extension contains geography-
level means and variances, not fitted models or posterior draw matrices.
